subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should this PR's cumulative accepted-attempt main-session restart-recovery fuse be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95750?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proof-positive, but it intentionally changes persisted recovery behavior and competes with another open candidate for the same bug, so automation should not choose the permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept This Durable Tombstone Contract
options.body: Treat the cumulative no-expiry main-session fuse as the intended compatibility change, rebase/check the exact head, land this PR, and redirect the competing open PR.

options.title: Require Exact-Head Proof After Rebase
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor rebases on current main and repeats the focused recovery suites plus the real behavior proof on the landing head.

options.title: Pause While Comparing Candidates
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers compare https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083 and choose one persisted recovery-state shape.

recommendation.title: Accept This Durable Tombstone Contract
recommendation.body: Treat the cumulative no-expiry main-session fuse as the intended compatibility change, rebase/check the exact head, land this PR, and redirect the competing open PR.
